fields.title: Retained mechanical weather conventions
fields.finding: Wind load, pad sizing and reference convection retain 048 reference-density conventions. Mean centre pressure omits a full finite-height hydrostatic shell load. Fatigue, local support details, control and propulsion remain outside the payload screen.
fields.missing_evidence: Weather-dependent installed loads, local support design and controlled-flight analysis.

claim: Wind load, pad sizing and reference convection retain 048 reference-density conventions. Mean centre pressure omits a full finite-height hydrostatic shell load. Fatigue, local support details, control and propulsion remain outside the payload screen. | Retained mechanical weather conventions
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Available weather points are not operational availability. The later 058 day fractions omit exclusions and do not prove a feasible continuous history with admitted air, ballast and ground recovery.
